name: Shade
role: assassin / rogue: fastest on the strip, burst from Veil, the party’s locksmith
description: Dual daggers, a half-cloak and a two-beat rhythm: disappear, then appear exactly where it hurts. The Shade flanks the back row from the front, poisons what it cannot cut, and opens every lock and purse on the way.

schools.name: Shadow
schools.philosophy: Be elsewhere, then be exactly there. Stealth, crits and the backstab from the front row; everything that says "from Veil" doubles while hidden.

schools.name: Venom
schools.philosophy: The fight is already won; the enemy has not noticed. Poison that ticks on their turn and ignores armor, debuffs, and the Shadow element.

schools.name: Larceny
schools.philosophy: The dungeon pays those who ask impolitely. Locks, mid-fight steals, pocketed traps and more gold for the party.

aiRuleDefault: IF self HP < 30% THEN item small hp potion on self; IF self not status veil THEN veil; ELSE backstab on weakest enemy

visual.notes: A narrow vertical blade of a figure broken by one diagonal, the half-cloak over the left shoulder; the half-mask and the knife handles at the belt must read at 200px. Veiled, the set drops to 40% opacity with a violet rim light.

pros: Highest burst: Veil then Backstab is 3.0× with +30% Crit Rate at Tier I
Flanks the back row from the front row; Poison keeps ticking while it hides
Lockpicking +2, gold stolen mid-fight, locked chests that roll a grade up
cons: 103 HP and Defense 20 at creation; Dodge is the only defence and caps at 30%
Pierce versus Plate: bone knights take its daggers at ×0.67 until Tier IV
Needs a setup turn: an ambushed Shade spends its first turn surviving, not Veiling
